COLLEGE OF ARTS AND HUMANITIES (ARHU) GLOBAL ENGAGEMENT REQUIREMENT
September 2023
Synthetic parser fixture. All students pursuing a B.A. degree use a conditional route.
Credits are in parentheses; terminal styling is bold face and underlined.
The final sequence course cannot be taken Pass/Fail; minimum grade = D-.
Placement: students must take prior to course registration.
